find:
for (const a of avoid) if (Math.hypot(a.x - p.x, a.y - p.y) < pairRequired) return false;
      return true;
why: pickVersusSpawnCell's candidate eligibility must include pairwise clearance against every already-placed spawn, not only wall/boundary clearance. Without it, the 5x5 cellSize-0.6 fixture keeps an 8-cell eligible pool (all within 1.15 of avoid) and picks an eligible diagonal, where the real filter empties the pool and falls back to the unfiltered ranking's far-corner pick -- the fixture asserts that fallback equality.
killedBy: clearance-filtered candidate pools (issue #225) pairwise clearance can empty the pool: every eligible cell sits within 1.15 of avoid, so the fallback engages
